children: Medtronic plc reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to $9.76B and diluted EPS of $1.14, driven by strength in Cardiovascular and an extra fiscal week that boosted reported sales versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was led by Cardiovascular, which rose about 20%, and benefited from an extra fiscal week that contributed roughly $570M to the quarter.
Medtronic reorganized its Cardiovascular business into four divisions (EPT, ICT, CVS, PVH) and moved Diabetes out of reportable segments.
Product momentum included adoption of PulseSelect, Micra, Evolut TAVR, Onyx Frontier, Hugo RAS, the AiBLE spine ecosystem, and new MiniMed launches.
M&A activity included the closing of Scientia Vascular (June 2026) and SPR Therapeutics (July 2026) to bolster Specialty Therapies and Neuromodulation.
Operationally, Medtronic completed the MiniMed IPO in March 2026 while retaining control; the extra fiscal week materially affected reported period results.
